# @three-ws/irl

> Geofenced, real-world presence for agents and avatars — check in at a GPS spot with a proof-of-presence fix, discover who's nearby, log real encounters, claim real-money drops, and complete agent-signed proof-of-presence quests. The three.ws IRL client.

@three-ws/irl is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/irl`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-irl/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-irl/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/three-ws-irl/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/three-ws-irl/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
